search_text: published ZDI-08-066 ZDI-CAN-335 Novell eDirectory Core Protocol Opcode 0x24 Heap Overflow Vulnerability 2008-10-08 CVE-2008-4480 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2008-4480 ['Novell'] ['eDirectory'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Novell eDirectory Server. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within dhost.exe, the service responsible for directory replication which is bound by default to TCP port 524. Improper parsing within opcode 0x24 via the Netware Core Protocol can result in an arithmetic calculation based on supplied user-input resulting in an under-allocated heap buffer. This fault can be leveraged to result in arbitrary code execution. Novell has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: http://www.novell.com/support/php/search.do?cmd=displayKC&docType=kc&externalId=7001183&sliceId=1&docTypeID=DT_TID_1_1&dialogID=78066829&stateId=0%200%2078062953 ['2008-05-19 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2008-10-08 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Sebastian Apelt (webmaster@buzzworld.org) https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-08-066/
title: Novell eDirectory Core Protocol Opcode 0x24 Heap Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Novell eDirectory Server. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within dhost.exe, the service responsible for directory replication which is bound by default to TCP port 524. Improper parsing within opcode 0x24 via the Netware Core Protocol can result in an arithmetic calculation based on supplied user-input resulting in an under-allocated heap buffer. This fault can be leveraged to result in arbitrary code execution.
